description: This file defines the interface and data structures for UART shell transport in Zephyr, including configurations, structures for different UART modes, macros for instance creation, and accessor functions.

methods.name: shell_backend_uart_get_ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the shell UART backend instance.

methods.name: shell_uart_smp_shell_data_get_ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the SMP shell data associated with the UART shell transport.
